name: Flight 7
summary: Flight 7 debuted the Block 2 ship and carried 10 Starlink mass simulators. Booster 14 returned to OLP-1 and was caught by the tower at T+6:55, the second successful catch. Ship 33 began losing engines at T+7:39 and telemetry was lost at T+8:26 near 146 km, shortly before planned engine cutoff. SpaceX traced the loss to a harmonic response stronger in flight than in testing, which caused propellant leaks and fires in the aft section, and debris fell around the Turks and Caicos Islands.
highlights: First flight of a Block 2 ship
Ship lost about 27 seconds before planned engine cutoff
Debris seen over the Turks and Caicos Islands

objectives.label: Ship reentry and Indian Ocean splashdown

payload.name: Starlink mass simulators
payload.description: About 20,000 kg of simulators; not deployed.

boosterFate: Caught by the OLP-1 tower chopsticks at T+6:55. Reflown on Flight 9.
shipFate: Telemetry lost at T+8:26 near 146 km; broke up over the Caribbean near the Turks and Caicos Islands.
